edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a protective direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.mechanism: TRT aims to reduce distress by pairing counseling with sound therapy so the tinnitus signal becomes less salient and less threatening to the auditory system.
edges.summary: The anchor for this edge is the 2026 AlGhamdi meta analysis in Acta Otorhinolaryngol Ital, which suggests that tinnitus retraining therapy tracks with lower risk or better outcomes for tinnitus. Later papers point in much the same direction, so the live uncertainty is usually about effect size or which subgroups carry the signal most strongly.
edges.caveats: Healthier-user bias, screening intensity, and baseline risk can all inflate apparent benefit in observational work, so the magnitude should be read conservatively.
